scenario: I am an employee of a bank in Germany. I have many loyal customers who trust me and my bank. Among them is one family of five who is deeply in debt and does not fulfill the conditions for being granted another loan. I see an undetectable way to falsify the family's credit score, allowing them to qualify for the loan. At the same time, I would abuse the trust of the other customers and of my colleagues. But if I do this, I will be able to prevent the family from selling their second car.
entities: I,family member 1 of the indebted family of 5,family member 2 of the indebted family of 5,family member 3 of the indebted family of 5,family member 4 of the indebted family of 5,family member 5 of the indebted family of 5,many other loyal customers of my bank,an unknown number of my colleagues at the bank
outcomes: The family is denied the additional loan.
The family remains under heavy debt pressure.
The family sells their second car.
My colleagues are not deceived by me.
The bank does not take on an ineligible loan.
